lyricConnections.explanationJa: 「急ぐ必要はない」。相手を安心させるときにも使える。
「思い切ってやってみる」。結果が分からなくても一歩踏み出す表現。
「時間をかけてゆっくりする」。相手に合わせて your を our に替えられる。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I had a really good time with you tonight.
sentences.displayHtml: I had a really good time with you tonight.

sentences.text: No need to rush back inside.
sentences.displayHtml: No need to rush back inside.

conversation.japanese: 今夜は君といてすごく楽しかった。急いで中に戻らなくていいよ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I was actually hoping we could stay out here for a minute.
sentences.displayHtml: I was actually hoping we could stay out here for a minute.

conversation.japanese: ありがとう。実は、もう少しここにいたいと思ってたの。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Good, because I wanted to ask you something.
sentences.displayHtml: Good, because I wanted to ask you something.

sentences.text: Could we take a chance and go out together this weekend?
sentences.displayHtml: Could we take a chance and go out together this weekend?

conversation.japanese: よかった、聞きたいことがあったんだ。思い切って、今週末に二人で出かけてみない？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I was wondering if you would ask.
sentences.displayHtml: I was wondering if you would ask.

conversation.japanese: 聞いてくれないかなって思ってた。うん、ぜひ。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: We can take our time choosing a place tomorrow.
sentences.displayHtml: We can take our time choosing a place tomorrow.

conversation.japanese: よかった。行く場所は明日ゆっくり決めよう。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: For now, let us just enjoy the quiet.
sentences.displayHtml: For now, let us just enjoy the quiet.

conversation.japanese: いいね。今はこの静かな時間を楽しもう。
